Full-Stack Software Developer
Location:
Sydney NSW
Employment Type:
Full-time (40 hours per week)
Salary Range:
$90,000 + (based on experience)
About Us
We are a growing group of companies looking to streamline and modernize our operations through purpose-built digital solutions. Our team is dedicated to building cutting-edge platforms, from CRM systems and custom software to websites and AI-driven tools, all designed to enhance workflow efficiency and business performance.
We’re looking for a passionate and experienced
who thrives in solving real-world business challenges through technology. This role will be hands-on, diverse, and offer the opportunity to drive innovation across multiple business units.Familiarity with manufacturing/supply chain systems is favourable
The Role
As a
Full-Stack Developer
, you will be responsible for:
Designing, developing, and maintaining custom
CRM platforms
tailored to business needs.
Building and managing modern, responsive
web applications and websites
.
Integrating APIs
and connecting disparate systems into cohesive workflows.
Exploring, implementing, and optimizing
AI-powered solutions
to automate tasks and enhance decision-making.
Working closely with management and staff to translate requirements into scalable solutions.
Ensuring all solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with best practices.
Maintaining technical documentation and version control.
What We’re Looking For
Qualifications & Experience
Degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
Minimum
5 years of commercial software development experience
Proven track record in
full-stack development
with strong front-end and back-end expertise.
Technical Skills
Proficiency in
HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Node.js
, and frameworks such as
React or Angular
Experience with
databases
(SQL & NoSQL).
Strong understanding of
RESTful APIs
and
microservices architecture
Familiarity with
cloud platforms
(Google Cloud Platform preferred, AWS/Azure considered).
Knowledge of
AI/ML libraries, frameworks, or APIs
(e.g., TensorFlow, OpenAI, LangChain).
Experience in
version control systems
(Git/GitHub).
Solid grasp of software architecture, scalability, and modular design principles.
Familiarity with manufacturing/supply chain systems: orders, fulfilment, invoicing.
Experience building or customising CRMs/ERPs (e.g., Odoo, Zoho, Dynamics 365).
Ability to map workflow pain points (e.g., call centre, factory dispatch, invoicing) into system features.
Soft Skills
Excellent problem-solving ability and a passion for innovation.
Strong communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
A proactive mindset with the confidence to recommend and implement improvements.
Why Join Us?
Be part of a forward-thinking team shaping digital transformation across multiple industries.
Work on diverse projects—from CRM systems to AI-driven automation.
Direct impact on streamlining business operations and staff workflows.
Competitive salary package ($80,000–$110,000).
Stable, long-term full-time role (NO recruiters, NO international applicants).
Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
How many years' experience do you have as a full stack developer?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have in a software development role?
How many years' experience do you have as an Artificial Intelligence Developer?
Which of the following programming languages are you experienced in?
Which of the following front end development libraries and frameworks are you proficient in?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Don’t provide your bank or credit card details when applying for jobs.
What can I earn as a Full Stack Developer
See more detailed salary information
